items.t: Takata front airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Lexus dealer
items.note: Free at any Lexus dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Engine stalls from failing fuel pump (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Lexus dealer
items.note: Free at any Lexus dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Variable valve timing gear bolts can loosen (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Lexus dealer
items.note: Free at any Lexus dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Fuel pulsation damper can leak fuel (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Lexus dealer
items.note: Free at any Lexus dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Lexus dealer
items.note: Free at any Lexus dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Fuel leak at the fuel pressure sensor (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Lexus dealer
items.note: Free at any Lexus dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Valve springs can break (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Lexus dealer
items.note: Free at any Lexus dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Carbon buildup causing rough idle and misfires
items.job: Walnut-blast clean the intake valves (intake manifold removed)
items.note: A shop that does this job says it takes two technicians about 3 hours. Owners report quotes of $869 and $1,600. Parts are mainly intake gaskets and blasting media. Rule out coils and plugs first.

items.t: Water pump leaking coolant
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant
items.note: RepairPal lists about $760-$1,020 for a 2008 IS 350. The IS F's V8 can cost more.

items.t: Convertible hardtop won't open or close
items.job: Diagnose retractable hardtop fault
items.note: Diagnosis only: the cause can be a sensor, a switch, low hydraulic fluid, a pump or a seal, and repair costs vary widely. RepairPal lists IS diagnosis at about $122-$179.

items.t: Harsh 2-3 shift and misfire codes on the IS 300 automatic
items.job: Diagnose shift and misfire codes; check whether the Lexus bulletin update applies
items.note: Diagnosis only: the fix depends on whether the bulletin's engine computer update covers your car or another misfire cause is found. RepairPal lists IS 300 diagnosis at about $122-$179.

items.t: Misfires from oil in spark plug wells or failing coils
items.job: Replace valve cover gaskets and tube seals, plus ignition coil(s) as needed
items.note: RepairPal lists about $560-$750 for valve cover gaskets and $770-$1,000 for coil replacement on a 2003 IS 300. Replacing a single coil costs much less.

items.t: Check engine light from failed oxygen sensors
items.job: Replace one oxygen sensor
items.note: RepairPal lists about $310-$350 for a 2003 IS 300.

items.t: Sticky or melting dashboard on the IS 300
items.job: Replace dashboard pad or fit a dash cover
items.note: Owners report about $400 on average at CarComplaints. A molded dash cover is the cheap fix.

items.t: Front-end clunk from worn control arm bushings or ball joints
items.job: Replace one front control arm, then align
items.note: RepairPal lists about $370-$490 per arm on a 2003 IS 300. Doing several arms at once costs more.

items.t: Front tires wearing on the inside edge
items.job: Four-wheel alignment
items.note: RepairPal lists about $195-$285 for a 2003 IS 300. Worn bushings or new tires add to the cost.

items.t: Worn engine and transmission mounts
items.job: Replace one engine mount
items.note: RepairPal lists about $400-$480 for a 2003 IS 300.

items.t: CD changer or radio knob stops working
items.job: Diagnose CD changer or radio fault
items.note: Diagnosis only: a stuck disc, a failed changer or a worn knob each cost very different amounts to fix. RepairPal lists IS 300 electrical diagnosis at about $122-$179.

items.t: Cruise control won't engage
items.job: Diagnose cruise control; check whether the switch campaign was done
items.note: Diagnosis only: the switch is the usual cause on 2002 cars, but a brake switch or other fault can also stop cruise from working. RepairPal lists IS 300 electrical diagnosis at about $122-$179. The Lexus switch campaign was free if it still applies.

items.t: Clutch chirp with the pedal released
items.job: Diagnose clutch noise
items.note: Diagnosis only: the fix depends on whether the bulletin's fix for the release parts is enough or new clutch release parts are needed. YourMechanic lists about $95-$115 to inspect clutch noise on an IS 300.

items.t: A/C blows the wrong temperature or from the wrong vents
items.job: Replace A/C servo (door) motor
items.note: May be free under Lexus program 20LE01 if your car still qualifies.

items.t: Front brakes squeal or squeak
items.job: Replace front brake pads
items.note: RepairPal lists about $340-$400 for a 2016 IS 350. Ask the dealer whether the squeal bulletin's revised pads apply.

items.t: Navigation screen flashes pink or goes black
items.job: Navigation software update at a Lexus dealer
items.note: If the update doesn't help, a display or head unit replacement costs much more.

items.t: Knocking noise from the vacuum pump at idle
items.job: Replace brake vacuum pump
items.note: RepairPal lists $969-$1,100 for a 2021 IS 350; YourMechanic lists about $1,340 for 2016-2018 ($1,660-$2,600 at shops). Have the dealer confirm the bulletin's repair first; it may be covered under warranty.

items.t: Rattle at idle from a fuel line touching the body
items.job: Find the rattle and reposition or clamp the fuel line (bulletin L-SB-0040-19)
items.note: Diagnosis only: finding the noise is most of the job; the bulletin fix itself is usually small. RepairPal lists IS 350 general diagnosis at about $122-$179. May be covered if your car is still under warranty.

items.t: Hard starting with lean check engine codes
items.job: Replace fuel pump (Lexus bulletin L-SB-0005-23)
items.note: YourMechanic lists about $873 for most 2006-2013 IS 350s ($1,036-$1,514 at shops); hours are estimated from its labor figure because the bulletin points to the flat-rate manual. The 6-year/70,000-mile powertrain warranty applies if your car is still inside it.

items.t: Bluetooth phone won't pair or keeps dropping
items.job: Diagnose Bluetooth fault and update head unit software
items.note: Diagnosis only: a software update usually fixes it, but a failed head unit costs much more. RepairPal lists IS 350 electrical diagnosis at about $122-$179.

items.t: Check engine light with oxygen sensor code P013A
items.job: Diagnose code P013A using Lexus tech tip L-TT-0311-22
items.note: Diagnosis only: the tech tip says to check the code before replacing the sensor. RepairPal lists check engine light diagnosis on a 2022 IS 350 at about $122-$179. If a rear oxygen sensor is needed, YourMechanic lists about $950-$1,220 on 2012-2016 IS 350s. A 2022 car may still be under the emissions warranty.

items.t: Remote app and connected services stop working
items.job: Diagnose telematics fault and apply bulletin update
items.note: Diagnosis only: the fix may be a software update, an account issue or a telematics module replacement. RepairPal lists IS 350 electrical diagnosis at about $122-$179. Check your connected-services subscription first.

items.t: Check engine light with idle or throttle codes on the V8
items.job: Replace throttle body and engine ventilation hoses (bulletin L-SB-0032-25)
items.note: RepairPal lists $1,313-$1,416 for an IS F throttle body; YourMechanic lists about $1,900 ($2,310-$3,560 at shops). Hours are estimated from YourMechanic's labor figure. An IS 500 may still be under warranty.

items.t: 12-volt battery runs down when the car sits
items.job: Test and replace 12-volt battery
items.note: A battery that only ran down from sitting may just need a full recharge.

items.t: Clunk on downshifts when slowing down
items.job: Engine and transmission software update (bulletin L-SB-0048-25)
items.note: Software only, so no parts. An owner quoting the bulletin gives 1.1 hours of labor; it is normally covered while the car is under the Lexus powertrain warranty.
